name: Petit Déj
source:
Petit Déj. Breakfast, in French.

A short visual novel about a withering marriage. Cook breakfast from the perspective of a spouse of an ever-distant husband. Learn about their relationship through the food you make. Perhaps their relationship can be saved...or perhaps their marriage will be ruined forever.

[From [url=https://calchoo.itch.io/petit-dej]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小德杰。早餐，法语。

一部关于凋零婚姻的短篇视觉小说。从远方丈夫的配偶的角度做早餐。通过你制作的食物了解他们的关系。也许他们的关系可以挽救……或者也许他们的婚姻将永远被毁。

[来自[url=https://calchoo.itch.io/petit-dej]Itch.io[/url]]
